name: Case law: Germany, Bundespatentgericht
label: Germany case law (Bundespatentgericht)
coverage: 31203 published decisions of the Bundespatentgericht, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 92410 citations of federal law linked to germany-law (19865 of them pinned to the article's version in force that day; the others are older than germany-law's record).
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. The record ends at the corpus snapshot named in REPRODUCE.md.
